# EPEDE — Electrical Power Engineering Digital Environment
> Authoritative, interconnected digital knowledge platform and interactive engineering exploration suite for electrical power systems, high-voltage substations, transmission networks, industrial installations, and the Cameroon National Power Grid (SONATREL / ENEO).
> Designed & developed by Mounjouonpou Yaya (Electrical and Power Systems Engineer).
> Canonical URL: https://epede-platform.vercel.app

## Overview & Architecture
- [System Architecture & Full Technical Spec](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Complete textual technical specification and audit guide for LLMs.
- [Sitemap](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of platform routes and modules.
- [Canonical Entrypoint](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/): Interactive Application built on React 19, TypeScript 5.8, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Lucide Icons, and Three.js.

## The Canonical Physical Energy Chain & 16 Core Domains
- [0. Foundations](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/journey): Electrotechnical fundamentals, AC circuit theory, electrical symbols, engineering documentation, and safety (LOTO).
- [D01 — Energy Resources & Generation](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D01): Hydroelectric plants (Francis, Pelton, Kaplan turbines), thermal gas turbine cycles, solar PV parks, synchronous alternators, excitation systems, and plant auxiliaries.
- [D02 — Power-System Architecture & Grid Planning](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D02): Grid topology, long-term transmission planning, generation-load balance, N-1 contingency, and dynamic stability.
- [D03 — Transmission Networks](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D03): 225 kV, 110 kV, and 90 kV overhead lines, steel lattice towers, bundled ACSR conductors, corona losses, surge impedance loading (SIL: Z_c = sqrt(L/C)), and OPGW.
- [D04 — Substations & Grid Nodes](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D04): Air-Insulated (AIS) and Gas-Insulated (GIS) substations, busbar topologies, disconnectors, SF6/Vacuum circuit breakers, instrument transformers (CT/VT), and bay interlocking logic.
- [D05 — Distribution Networks (MV/LV)](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D05): 15 kV and 30 kV distribution loops, Ring Main Units (RMU, 24 kV for 15 kV grids, 36 kV for 30 kV grids), pole-mounted H61 transformers, and 400 V / 230 V networks.
- [D06 — Electrical Installations & Industrial LV](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D06): Low-voltage distribution boards (TGBT Form 1-4b), earthing regimes (TT, TN-C, TN-S, IT), disconnection times per IEC 60364-4-41, cable sizing, and protection.
- [D07 — Industrial Automation, Drives & Control](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D07): Motor starters (DOL, Star-Delta, Soft Starter), Variable Frequency Drives (VFD), PLC architectures, P&ID reading (ISA-5.1), and control loops.
- [D08 — Extra-Low Voltage & Special Systems (ELV/CFA)](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D08): Structured cabling, fiber-optic distribution, CCTV surveillance, access control, and fire detection systems.
- [D09 — Advanced Technologies & Digital Twin](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D09): Substation digital twins, IoT telemetry, asset health analytics, and OT cybersecurity boundaries.
- [D10 — Energy Storage & EV Infrastructure](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D10): Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) chemistry, bidirectional Power Conversion Systems (PCS), and EV fast charging.
- [D11 — Protection Relaying, Measurement & Fault Studies](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D11): ANSI protection functions (50/51 overcurrent, 21 distance, 87T/87L differential, 67N directional), instrument transformer CT/VT sizing, and symmetrical fault analysis (IEC 60909).
- [D12 — Substation Automation Systems (SAS) & Telecontrol](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D12): IEC 61850 architecture, Station bus (MMS, GOOSE), Process bus (Sampled Values - IEC 61850-9-2LE), and IEEE 1588 PTP microsecond synchronization.
- [D13 — Operational Communications & OT Networks](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D13): Industrial Ethernet, teleprotection signaling, IEC 60870-5-104 SCADA protocol, and OPGW transmission telecommunication.
- [D14 — Power Quality & Electromagnetic Compatibility](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D14): Total Harmonic Distortion (THD_V < 8% for LV per IEEE 519-2022), voltage unbalance, flicker (Pst, Plt), passive LC filters, and active harmonic filters.
- [D15 — Smart Metering & Grid Digitalization](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D15): Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI), DLMS/COSEM communication, PLC/cellular backhaul, and STS prepaid tokens.
- [D16 — Earthing Systems, Lightning & Electrical Safety](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D16): Mesh grounding grids (touch and step voltage safety per IEEE 80-2013), rolling sphere lightning protection (IEC 62305), and workplace electrical safety.

## Cameroon National Power Grid (Observatory & Network Explorer)
- [Cameroon Grid Explorer](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/cameroon-grid): Complete geographical and electrical network model of Cameroon's Southern Interconnected Grid (RIS) and Northern Interconnected Grid (RIN).
- Key Power Plants:
  - Song Loulou Hydroelectric Dam (384 MW, 8 Francis units, Sanaga River, primary frequency regulation)
  - Nachtigal Hydroelectric Power Plant (420 MW, 7 Francis units of 60 MW)
  - Edéa Hydroelectric Facility (276 MW, mixed Francis/Kaplan units)
  - Memve’ele Hydroelectric Dam (211 MW, Ntem River, evacuated via 225 kV Nyabizan–Ebolowa–Ahala line)
  - Lagdo Hydroelectric Dam (72 MW, Benue River, RIN)
  - Kribi Gas Power Plant (216 MW, Wärtsilä dual-fuel engines fired by Sanaga South gas)
  - Lom Pangar Reservoir Dam (6 billion m³ regulating reservoir holding Sanaga flow at ~1,000 m³/s)
- Key Transmission Corridors (SONATREL 225 kV & 90 kV):
  - 225 kV Song Loulou – Bekoko (Douala hub)
  - 225 kV Song Loulou – Mangombe – Oyomabang (Yaoundé hub)
  - 225 kV Nachtigal – Nyom II (Yaoundé injection)
  - 225 kV Nachtigal – Wouro Soua (RIS-RIN interconnection tie, under construction / PIRECT project)
  - 90 kV regional sub-transmission rings around Douala and Yaoundé

## Interactive Educational Solvers (Worked Examples)
- [Short-Circuit Sensitivity Model (IEC 60909)](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/calculators): Initial symmetrical short-circuit current (Ik''), peak current (ip), breaking current (Ib), and thermal equivalent current (Ith).
- [Cable Sizing & Voltage Drop (IEC 60364-5-52)](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/calculators): Current-carrying capacity, derating factors, and voltage drop sensitivity.
- [Transformer Sizing & Losses](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/calculators): Apparent power demand, load factor, active and reactive losses.
- [Power Factor Correction](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/calculators): Required capacitor reactive power Qc and harmonic resonance checks.
- [Interactive Single-Line Diagram (SLD)](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/diagrams): Vector graphics SLD with live breaker switching, busbar energization highlighting, and interlock rules.
- [Substation Pedagogical Simulator](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/substations): Bay control logic and disconnector/earth switch interlocking verification.

## Equipment Catalog (38 Canonical Types)
- Primary Switching: SF6 live-tank circuit breakers (245 kV), vacuum circuit breakers (36 kV, 24 kV, 12 kV), horizontal knee disconnectors, pantograph disconnectors.
- Instrument Transformers: Inductive voltage transformers (VT/TT), current transformers (CT/TC), capacitive voltage transformers (CVT).
- Grid Protection: Numeric multifunction relays (Siemens Siprotec, Schneider Micom, ABB Relion).
- Distribution: Modular Ring Main Units (RMU), pole-mounted three-phase transformers (H61).
- Industrial Apparatus: Low-voltage air circuit breakers (ACB), molded-case circuit breakers (MCCB), motor protection circuit breakers (MPCB), variable frequency drives (VFD).
